University of Rajasthan (UOR) has released the notification for 4 vacancies, including Research Associate and Project Assistant posts. Eligible candidates can submit their offline applications till 27 November 2026.

The Department of Community and Applied Science (earlier known as Home Science), University of Rajasthan, Jaipur, needs two Research Associates at Rs. 47000/- + HRA and two Project Assistants at Rs. 25000/- for RUSA 2.0 Project XI, "Sustainable strategies for improving the Nutritional and Health status of Vulnerable groups in Tonk District". The appointment is temporary and runs till 31 March 2027. Research Associates need a Ph.D. in Foods & Human Nutrition (submitted or awarded), and Project Assistants need an M.Sc in Foods & Human Nutrition / Human Development & Family & Development Communication & Extension. Paper applications must reach the department before 4:00 PM on 27 November 2026.

About University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026

The posts are in the Department of Community and Applied Science, earlier known as Home Science, at the University of Rajasthan, Jaipur-302004. The work is for Project XI under RUSA 2.0, a study titled "Sustainable strategies for improving the Nutritional and Health status of Vulnerable groups in Tonk District". The notice refers to Office Order No. F.35-532/PP/P-11/2026/2706 dated 24.10.2026, and it is signed by Prof. Reshma Boolchandani (PI) and Prof. Shubha Dube (Co PI).

The notice announces 4 posts in total.

Pay and Tenure

  • Research Associate: Rs. 47000/- plus HRA.
  • Project Assistant: Rs. 25000/-. The notice mentions no HRA for this post.

University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026 Job Description

Research Associate

  • Will undertake the necessary work required for completion of the project.
  • Will carry out the necessary field work in study area.
  • Will do the interpretation & compilation of the analyzed data.
  • Will do the report writing.

Project Assistant

  • Will be required to carry out the field visits in the study area for reinforcing the key messages imparted.
  • Will develop messages for IEC material and spread awareness in the field regarding the same.
  • Will demonstrate nutrient rich recipes in the field for combating anemia among the vulnerable groups.
  • Will impart information regarding correct nutrition practices in the community in collaboration with AWW & helpers.
  • Will do the data tabulation.
  • Will help in report writing of the project.

How to Apply for University of Rajasthan Recruitment 2026

Applications are made on paper. The application form is printed with the notice under the University of Rajasthan letterhead, headed "Name of the Post for which apply under RUSA 2.0 Programme".

  1. Write the name of the post you are applying for and the name of the department at the top of the form.
  2. Complete the form sections: Personal Information, Educational Qualifications, Research Work/Publication, Workshops/Seminars/Conferences/Symposia Attended, Professional Experience, Thesis Details, References and Other information (Awards/recognitions).
  3. Affix a colour passport size photo in the box on the form.
  4. Sign the declaration with your full name, place and date.
  5. Attach the required documents with the application.
  6. Address the application to: PI, Project XI, RUSA 2.0, Department of Community and Applied Science, University of Rajasthan, Jaipur.
  7. Make sure the application reaches the Department of Community and Applied Science before 4:00 PM on 27 November 2026.

The notice does not specify whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand. It also does not list the required documents item by item.

Selection and Interview

Applications will be screened, and candidates shortlisted for an interview will be informed via email. Applicants should therefore write a working e-mail ID in the form. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for interview or travel. The notice does not give an interview date.

About ICF Hospital

ICF Hospital is a Railway hospital in Chennai (PIN 600 038). The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal Chief Medical Officer, ICF Hospital. The post falls under the Railway Board's scheme for engagement of Honorary Visiting Specialists (HVS) in Railway Hospitals, and the Railway Board letter No. 2014/H-1/12/8/HVS/Policy/E dated 22.10.2025 on revised honorarium rates is attached to the notice.

Where and How to Send

Use the application form titled "Application for Honorary Visiting Specialist" (Application for the Post of HVS (General Surgeon)), printed on pages 2 to 4 of the notice. Send it to this address:

The PCMO, ICF Hospital, ICF, Chennai – 600 038

  1. Fill in the form: name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth and age, nationality, community, e-mail, phone, postal address with PIN code, and qualifications from MBBS level onwards with year of passing, college/university and percentage of marks.
  2. Give your experience after the PG Degree/Diploma (period, hospital/organisation, certificate attached), including published research papers, if any.
  3. Enter your Medical Council of India/State registration number, date of issue and validity, your speciality and your place of present work (Government or Private).
  4. Affix a recent passport size photo duly attested by a Gazetted officer on the form.
  5. Attach attested Xerox copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below.
  6. Sign the declaration with place and date.
  7. Make sure the application reaches the PCMO on or before 15 December 2026.

The notice does not specify a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or what to write on the envelope.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

Educational Qualification and Experience

  • Post-Graduate degree from a recognized University.
  • Minimum 3 years experience in the professional work related to the concerned Specialty after obtaining the P.G. degree.

The application form also asks for the MBBS degree, an internship completion certificate and a valid registration certificate of the Medical Council of India/State. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

Age Limit

  • During first time engagement, the preferred age is between 30 years to 64 years.
  • The upper age limit of continued engagement is 65 years.

The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation.

Honorarium and Hours of Duty

Hours of DutySpecialist

The candidate may select any one of these Hours of Duty of their choice. The attached Railway Board letter gives these amounts as revised honorarium for a Specialist per month.

There will be a deduction in remuneration for any absence beyond 12 days per annum, as per the extant Railway Board order. The Railway Board letter sets the Specialist deduction at ₹4,167/- per day for the 4 hours a day, 6 days a week option and ₹3,812/- per day for the 4 hours a day, 4 days a week option. The letter adds that the honorarium rates will be revised after 05 years of its issue.

Enclosures

Xerox copies of these documents, duly attested, are to be attached:

  • Three recent passport size photos (including one to be pasted on the form)
  • Date of Birth Certificate
  • Valid Internship Completion Certificate
  • Degree of MBBS
  • Valid Registration Certificate of Medical Council of India/State
  • Post Graduate Degree/Diploma from a Recognized University
  • Experience Certificate
  • NOC from Government Organization, if already employed in a Central/State Govt Hospital

  • An application form incomplete in any respect is liable to be rejected.

  • If any information given is found false or incorrect at any stage before or after engagement, the contract is liable to be terminated, in addition to any civil and/or criminal legal action.
  • Other terms and conditions of the engagement are on the ICF website, http://www.icf.indianrailways.gov.in.

  • Ensuring plant parameters within the specified normal range values.
  • Start-up and shutdown of various pumps, blowers and electrical equipment such as Condensate Extraction pumps, Boiler feed pumps, OGDHR pumps and Fans, etc.
  • Start-up of steam water system, feed water heating, TG warm up and rolling, synchronization to GRID and sustained operation of TG set.
  • Assisting and guiding commissioning team during commissioning, testing and integrated operation.

Operations – Foreman/Senior Operator (TG and SWS System): 2 Posts

  • Round the clock operation.
  • Monitoring of various plant parameters and operation of equipment in TG, Steam and water system, and auxiliaries.
  • Recording plant parameters within the specified normal range values.
  • Field operation for start-up and shutdown of various pumps, blowers and electrical equipment such as Condensate Extraction pumps, Boiler feed pumps, OGDHR pumps and Fans, etc.
  • Field operations for start-up of steam water system, feed water heating, TG warm up and rolling, synchronization to GRID and sustained operation of TG set.
  • Assisting commissioning team during commissioning, testing and integrated operation.

Mechanical – Engineer (SO/F Level): 1 Post

  • Reviewing the maintenance procedures for TG and auxiliary systems.
  • Coordinate turbine rolling, barring gear operation and trial runs.
  • Maintenance of governing valves, control valves and stop valves, and of the EHC (Electro-Hydraulic Control) system.
  • Check functioning of turbine trip and emergency protection systems.
  • Maintenance of lube oil, control oil and jacking oil systems; condensate extraction pumps (CEP); boiler feed pumps (BFP) and their driving turbines/motors, as applicable; cooling water pumps and seal water pumps.
  • Maintenance of gland steam condenser and gland sealing system; vacuum pumps and air ejectors; heat exchangers, oil coolers and filters; circulating water and auxiliary cooling systems; HP and LP bypass valves.

Mechanical – Foreman/Senior Technician: 2 Posts

  • Conduct inspection of pumps, motors, gearboxes and rotating equipment.
  • Checking mechanical seals, gland packing, bearings and couplings.
  • Perform shaft alignment using dial gauges and laser alignment equipment.
  • Inspect piping, valves, flanges and expansion joints; carry out hydraulic testing and pressure testing wherever required.
  • Identify oil leakage, water leakage and steam leakage; monitor equipment health through vibration and temperature analysis.
  • Check rotor run-out, eccentricity, shaft alignment and bearing clearances; inspect and maintain journal bearings and thrust bearings; check bearing metal temperature, vibration and oil parameters.
  • Monitor differential expansion, axial displacement and rotor eccentricity; inspect gland sealing and labyrinth sealing arrangements.

Electrical – Engineer (SO/F Level): 1 Post

  • Supervise dismantling, cleaning, and inspection of internal components.
  • Checking and servicing of motor, gearbox, bearings, and seals.
  • Testing of local and remote operation, including control signals; preparation of service and test reports.
  • Inspection, testing & calibration of overload relays and protective relays; checking of control circuits, interlocks, and indication circuits.
  • Functional testing of motor feeders and protection circuits; testing of electrical and mechanical interlocks; troubleshooting of motor starter circuits and control wiring.
  • Preparation of maintenance and test procedures, inspection, and test reports.
  • Power evacuation system maintenance & condition monitoring.
  • Maintenance, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning of the electrical power evacuation system. This covers the Generator, exciter, voltage regulator, Generator Transformer, Unit Auxiliary transformer, Generator circuit breaker, Isolated phase bus duct, Generator relay protection, Generator control panel, overhead conductor, and 6.6 kV vacuum & 230kV SF6 gas insulated breakers, etc.

Electrical – Foreman/Senior Technician: 2 Posts

  • Dismantling, cleaning, and inspection of internal components; checking and servicing of motor, gearbox, bearings, and seals.
  • Calibration of torque and limit switches; setting and calibration of open/close limits and torque settings.
  • Checking of electrical connections, control circuits, and wiring; functional testing and verification of actuator operation.
  • Testing of local and remote operation, including control signals; inspection, testing & calibration of overload relays and protective relays.
  • Checking of control circuits, interlocks, and indication circuits; functional testing of motor feeders and protection circuits; testing of electrical and mechanical interlocks.
  • Troubleshooting of motor starter circuits and control wiring; verification of earthing connections and panel safety arrangements.
  • Calibration and testing of electromagnetic relays, contactors, Numerical relay etc.

Instrumentation – Engineer (SO/F Level): 1 Post

  • Verification of control logic for various plant systems, including open-loop and closed-loop control logics.
  • Commissioning support for pneumatic control valves, including functional and operational verification.
  • Commissioning support for the TG governor control system.
  • Commissioning support for the High-Pressure (HP) Bypass system.
  • Review and verification of commissioning procedures, test reports and commissioning-related documents.

  • Loop checking of field transmitters and switches associated with SWS and TG systems.
  • Commissioning of field-mounted transmitters and switches.
  • Commissioning and functional testing of pneumatic control valves, and of electrically operated valves through DDCS.
  • Calibration of field instruments and transmitters.
  • Commissioning of Steam Water Analysis system as wet and dry panels, including associated online analysers.
